note_history.10-Q.key_note_tags.from: the current 10-Q XBRL instance 10-Q/clfd20260630_10q_htm.xml: every element whose local name ends in 'TextBlock' listed with ElementTree and a start-ns pass for the prefixes, importing nothing from src/, then each name read against the six key notes docs/INPUT_SPEC.md section 5 names — revenue_recognition_policy: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock, whose text opens 'Note 8. Revenue Revenue Recognition Our revenue is comprised of the sale of our products to customers', and us-gaap:DisaggregationOfRevenueTableTextBlock, its net-sales tables by geography ('United States', 'All other countries') and by customer type ('Broadband service providers'), as Dell's and Micron's readings took the same pair; critical_accounting_estimates: us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock, the note opening 'Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies', which says 'management is required to make estimates and assumptions that affect reported amounts of assets and liabilities', as the readings of Cisco, Ciena, Littelfuse, F5, NVIDIA and Adtran took that tag (us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock, us-gaap:ConsolidationPolicyTextBlock and us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock are single policy paragraphs inside it, which none of the readings took as the critical-accounting-estimates note); debt: us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock, 'Note 16. Debt On April 27, 2022, the Company entered into a loan agreement and a security agreement with a bank that provides the Company with a $40,000,000 revolving line of credit', the one note about what the company owes; no contingencies, related-party or subsequent-events note is tagged in either quarter - the notes run from Note 1 to Note 16 and none is titled for any of the three. us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealizedLossPositionFairValueTableTextBlock is the unrealized-loss table inside 'Note 4. Investments' ('The Company invests in United States Treasury securities'), the securities the company holds, and names no debt it owes, so it is not the debt note; us-gaap:InvestmentTextBlock and us-gaap:ScheduleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesReconciliationTableTextBlock are the same investments note. This is where the reading DISAGREES with the parser: src/note_history.py's 'debt' pattern matches the bare substring 'debt' and pairs us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealizedLossPositionFairValueTableTextBlock, the investments table, as the debt note, so it lists 5 where this reading lists 4
